name: junkd
description: Handoff, orch and tldr in one plugin: save and resume durable task context, drain a backlog with implementation and independent verification subagents, summarize or keep replies terse. The /junkd pane, the automatic handoff loop and the main-loop guard are Claude Code mods and do nothing here.

interface.shortDescription: Handoffs, the orch loop and TL;DR in one plugin
interface.longDescription: Writes durable Markdown handoffs and restores them by short id, runs a resumable task loop with isolated worktrees and evidence gates, and summarizes or keeps replies terse. The /junkd pane and the automatic handoff loop are Claude Code only.
defaultPrompt: Save a handoff for this task.
Process the next eligible task with orch.
Summarize my latest request in three sentences.
